label: <DEL> or first v/w/l/n/s late in input, gated by many m/r/j/p/0/y/k/b/f tokens seen earlier
explanation: Low-end candidate unit that fires almost only at the <DEL> step (44% of mass) or at the first occurrence of v, w, l, n or s in the original phase at t >= 3 (about 52% of mass; v and w are strongest). Together these triggers cover 91% of mass but have only 7.5% precision, because the unit also depends on context: it fires much more often when the sequence starts with m/r/j/0/y/p and when many tokens from {m,r,j,0,y,p,k,b,f} came earlier. It also fires more for longer sequences (L=8-9) and later positions. It is essentially silent in the copy phase, at t<2, on repeated tokens, and on digits or other letters as inputs. Requiring >=3 such earlier tokens gives dev F1 about 0.29 and mass recall 0.68. The context dependence is graded and does not reduce to a clean boolean rule.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: in_tok=v (+6.83), in_tok=w (+6.36), in_tok=s (+5.21), in_tok=l (+5.20), in_tok=n (+5.11), prev_tok=<DEL> (+4.08). Lower it: phase=2 (-11.37), orig0=v (-4.37), orig1=s (-3.65), orig1=c (-3.58).
